image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a wet, rocky substrate surrounded by small barnacles. The chiton has an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal shell composed of overlapping plates embedded in a textured girdle. The lighting is natural, highlighting the wet texture of the rock and the organism.
